execution_review.reason: Audited all 12 completed command executions, item_0 through item_11, and the event item types. Every command is a zsh wrapper around repository-local rg searches or nl/sed source reads, with only true and stderr redirection to /dev/null as auxiliary shell operations. Reads cover the RequestBody implementation, charset/bounds helpers and repository test source; tests are read, not run. The 274-line central RequestBody read covers the requested dispersed declarations and base contracts. No command accesses parent experiment files, case catalogs, criteria, other trials, the frozen runtime/skill or saved graph; none executes upstream code/tests/builds, writes repository files, invokes a graph tool, uses the web or delegates. All command events have exit code 0; the only other completed item is the final agent message. This passes the baseline evidence boundary, not a claim that everything read was included in the answer.
